cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：农业的
cards.example_en: We visited an agricultural show and saw cows that won prizes.
cards.example_zh: 我们参观了农业展览，看到了获奖的牛。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：每年的
cards.example_en: Our annual school fair raises money for new library books.
cards.example_zh: 我们一年一度的学校义卖为图书馆的新书筹款。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：临床的
cards.example_en: Students practise clinical skills at the hospital open day.
cards.example_zh: 学生们在医院开放日练习临床技能。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：数字的
cards.example_en: We use a digital clock in class.

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Wool is a warm material for coats in the northern winter.
cards.example_zh: 羊毛是北方冬天做大衣的保暖材料。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The gate is made of metal and rattles in strong wind.
cards.example_zh: 大门是金属做的，大风时会哗啦作响。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The biology textbook has a chapter on sexual reproduction in plants.
cards.example_zh: 生物课本里有一章讲植物的有性生殖。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：技术的
cards.example_en: The technical problem stopped the online class for ten minutes.
cards.example_zh: 技术故障让网课停了十分钟。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Grandma told us kind people go to heaven after they die.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶告诉我们，善良的人死后会上天堂。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: I cleaned the dusty screen before the online lesson.
cards.example_zh: 上网课之前，我把落满灰尘的屏幕擦干净了。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: His anger cooled after he talked with his father.
cards.example_zh: 他和父亲谈过以后，怒气就慢慢消了。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：天文学家
cards.example_en: The astronomer let us look at the moon through a telescope.
cards.example_zh: 天文学家让我们用望远镜观看月亮。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Doctors are working hard to treat lung cancer.
cards.example_zh: 医生们正在努力治疗肺癌。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The library computer crashed while I was printing my essay.
cards.example_zh: 我正在打印作文时，图书馆的电脑死机了。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：消费者
cards.example_en: Each consumer who tasted the new juice wrote a score on the card.
cards.example_zh: 每位品尝新果汁的消费者都在卡片上写了分数。
